tcs.test_item:
When a Voice Recognition (VR) session is active and a Traffic Announcement event is detected, the Audio Management software shall ignore the TA request unless the customer explicitly selects TA playback

(Confirm a traffic announcement is ignored during a VR session on non-amplifier and booster systems)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a Voice Recognition session
2. Trigger a traffic announcement event
3. Record the audio produced for the traffic announcement
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Voice Recognition session is active
2. The traffic announcement event is raised
3. No traffic announcement audio is produced
tcs.reasoning: 4866906 is the non-amplifier and booster systems half of the pair the same clause text carries at two anchors, so the amplifier type is the distinguishing token. This case takes the default branch, where the customer has not selected TA.

tcs.test_item:
When a Voice Recognition (VR) session is active and a Traffic Announcement event is detected, the Audio Management software shall ignore the TA request unless the customer explicitly selects TA playback

(Confirm a customer-selected traffic announcement does play on non-amplifier and booster systems)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a Voice Recognition session
2. Select the traffic announcement for activation
3. Trigger a traffic announcement event
4. Record the audio produced for the traffic announcement
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Voice Recognition session is active
2. The traffic announcement is selected for activation
3. The traffic announcement event is raised
4. The traffic announcement audio is produced
tcs.reasoning: The 'unless selected by the customer' exception at 4866906. Without it a system that ignored TA unconditionally would pass the first case.

tcs.test_item:

2. The Navigation prompt is selected for activation
3. The Navigation audio event is raised
4. The Voice Recognition session is cancelled and the Navigation audio plays
tcs.reasoning: 4866908 on non-amplifier and booster systems. Pairs against the delay case at the neighbouring anchor: selected cancels, unselected defers, and the customer selection is what separates them.

tcs.test_item:
When a VR session is active and a Navigation audio event is received that has not been enabled by the customer, the Audio Management software shall postpone Navigation playback until the VR session completes and then replay the pending Navigation announcement

(Confirm an unselected Navigation prompt is deferred and then replayed on non-amplifier and booster systems)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a Voice Recognition session
2. Trigger a Navigation audio event that is not selected for activation
3. Record the audio produced while the session runs
4. End the Voice Recognition session
5. Record the audio produced after the session ends
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Voice Recognition session is active
2. The Navigation audio event is raised
3. No Navigation audio is produced while the session runs
4. The Voice Recognition session ends
5. The Navigation announcement is repeated
tcs.reasoning: 4866911 on non-amplifier and booster systems requires both halves — ignored during the session and repeated after it. A system that simply dropped the event would satisfy the first half alone.

tcs.test_item:
If the Cabin EQ curve identifier is S00 or SFF, the Audio Management software shall substitute the default Cabin EQ profile (SDF) and report a Cabin EQ plausibility fault

(Confirm the null Cabin EQ identifier falls back to the default profile)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Configure the Cabin EQ curve identifier as "S00"
2. Start the head unit
3. Read the loaded Cabin EQ profile and record it
4. Read the reported fault and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Cabin EQ curve identifier is "S00"
2. The head unit starts
3. The loaded Cabin EQ profile is the default "SDF"
4. The Plausibility Cabin EQ Mismatch fault is set
tcs.reasoning: 4867579 names two invalid identifiers in one OR. This takes the null value; the second case takes the all-ones value, since a range check can catch one and miss the other.

tcs.test_item:
When a Voice Recognition (VR) session (Navigation, Phone, or Non-Phone) is active and an HFP call, E-Call, or R-Call is initiated, the Audio Management software shall terminate the active VR session before processing the call-related audio

(Confirm a hands-free call cancels an active Navigation VR session)

2. Initiate a hands-free call
3. Record the state of the Voice Recognition session
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Navigation Voice Recognition session is active
2. The hands-free call is initiated
3. The Voice Recognition session is cancelled
tcs.reasoning: 4866909 lists three call types against three VR session types. This takes HFP against a NAV session; the second case takes an emergency call, which reaches the same rule by a different trigger path.

tcs.test_item:
When a Voice Recognition (VR) session (Navigation, Phone, or Non-Phone) is active and an HFP call, E-Call, or R-Call is initiated, the Audio Management software shall terminate the active VR session before processing the call-related audio

3. Record the state of the Voice Recognition session
tcs.expected_result:

tcs.reasoning: Second call type at 4866909. The anchor is the R1L-R variant, which carries E-Call and R-Call where the neighbouring 4866910 stops at HFP, so the emergency path belongs to this leaf.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall assign and evaluate Entertainment audio with a lower audio priority than Information and Signal audio sources during audio focus arbitration. When a higher-priority Information or Signal source requests audio focus, the software shall apply the configured focus-loss behavior to the active Entertainment source

(Confirm an Information source outranks Entertainment in focus arbitration)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Request audio focus for an Information source
3. Record which source holds audio focus
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The Information source requests audio focus
3. The Information source holds audio focus
tcs.reasoning: 4865916 ranks Entertainment below both information and signal sources. This case takes the information half; the second takes the signal half, which the clause names separately.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall assign and evaluate Entertainment audio with a lower audio priority than Information and Signal audio sources during audio focus arbitration. 3. Record which source holds audio focus
tcs.expected_result:

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall assign higher audio-focus priority to Information sources than Entertainment sources. When an Information source requests audio focus while Entertainment audio is active, the software shall grant focus to the Information source and apply the configured focus-loss or ducking behavior to the Entertainment source

(Confirm focus passes to the Information source while Entertainment is playing)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Activate an Information source
3. Record which source holds audio focus and the state of the Entertainment audio
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The Information source becomes active
3. The Information source holds audio focus and the Entertainment audio yields
tcs.reasoning: 4865931 states the ranking from the Information side where 4865916 states it from the Entertainment side. The two anchors are separate objects, so each carries its own row; this one observes the grant, 004 observes the ranking.

tcs.test_item:
For amplified system configurations, the Audio Management software shall mix an active confirmation tone with the applicable ENT and/or INFO1 audio stream and provide the resulting audio stream through the configured amplifier output path. The output channel configuration shall correspond to the active ENT/INFO1 routing configuration

(Confirm a confirmation tone is overlaid on the Entertainment channel)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source on an amplified system
2. Trigger a confirmation tone
3. Record the audio present on the amplifier Entertainment channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The confirmation tone is triggered
3. The amplifier Entertainment channel carries both the Entertainment audio and the tone
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4865968 names two channels, ENT and INFO1. This takes ENT; the second takes INFO1, since a mix applied to one path does not imply the other.

tcs.test_item:

tcs.expected_result:

tcs.test_item:
For amplified system configurations, the Audio Management software shall exclude confirmation tones from the INFO2 audio path, ensuring that confirmation-tone audio is not mixed into an active INFO2 stream transmitted through the amplifier output path

(Confirm a confirmation tone is kept off the Information 2 channel)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Activate an Information 2 source on an amplified system
2. Trigger a confirmation tone
3. Record the audio present on the amplifier Information 2 channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Information 2 source is active
2. The confirmation tone is triggered
3. The amplifier Information 2 channel carries the Information 2 audio without the tone
tcs.reasoning: 4865969 is the suppression counterpart of 4865968. Written as a negative case because the defect it guards against is a tone leaking into a path that must stay clean.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall arbitrate concurrent audio requests according to the configured source priority, with INFO1 and INFO2 having higher priority than ENT

(Confirm source selection follows the established priorities and the user request)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Request an Information 1 source
3. Record which source is selected
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The Information 1 source is requested
3. The selected source follows the established source priorities
tcs.reasoning: Partial coverage, ruled at package 08 section 2.1. 4866054 covers source selection by established priority and user request, and this case goes no further than that wording. The leaf's duck, mute, reject and pause action set has no text anywhere in CFTS019 — zero hits — so it is not written; it is filed to DR-AM1 as material from the 1.3.4 condition tables or the {CFTS019-5129} cross-reference.

tcs.test_item:
When an INFO2 source becomes active, the Audio Management software shall grant INFO2 priority over active ENT and INFO1 sources and shall transition the conflicting ENT/INFO1 streams to the configured interrupted state. The software shall prevent conflicting user-initiated Entertainment playback from becoming active while INFO2 remains active

(Confirm an activating Information 2 source takes priority over the conflicting streams)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Activate an Information 2 source
3. Record which source holds priority and the state of the Entertainment stream
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The Information 2 source becomes active
3. The Information 2 source holds priority and the Entertainment stream is interrupted
tcs.reasoning: Shares 4866055 with SWE1_AMM_032 under R-AM16, the upstream having split one CFTS requirement into two SWE leaves. Per that ruling the two brackets must state different emphases: this row observes the priority grant and the transition to the interrupted state.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall apply INFO2 as a higher-priority audio source than ENT and INFO1. Upon activation of an INFO2 source, the software shall interrupt active ENT and INFO1 streams having pause/stop capability and shall prevent such streams from resuming until all active INFO2 sources are inactive

(Confirm a pausable source stays paused until every Information 2 source ends)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play a USB media track
2. Activate an Information 2 source
3. Record the transport state of the USB media source
4. End the Information 2 source
5. Record the transport state of the USB media source again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The USB media track plays
2. The Information 2 source becomes active
3. The USB media source reports the paused state
4. The Information 2 source ends
5. The USB media source resumes
tcs.reasoning: The other half of the R-AM16 shared anchor: this row observes the pause of a source with pause capability and its release once no Information 2 source remains. spec_reference carries 4866054 as well, because the leaf's opening sentence on INFO2 outranking ENT and INFO1 belongs to that object rather than to 4866055.

tcs.test_item:
During Ignition Working Conditions, the Audio Management software shall monitor active Entertainment and Information audio sources and apply the configured audio priority and routing policy to determine the audible source on each audio output channel

(Confirm the priority rules hold across Entertainment, Information and Signal sources)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source under an Ignition Working Condition
2. Activate an Information source
3. Trigger a signal source
4. Record which source is audible on each output channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The Information source becomes active
3. The signal source is raised
4. The audible source on each output channel follows the configured priority
tcs.reasoning: Re-anchored to 4866442 per package 08 section 2.7 on coverage rather than similarity: the earlier candidate 4866220 scopes itself to at least two information sources, narrower than the leaf, while 4866442 spans Entertainment, Information and Signal under any Ignition Working Condition.

tcs.test_item:
When two Information sources are active and a Signal source becomes active, the Audio Management software shall mix the Signal source with all output channels while applying the configured ducking level to the Information sources

(Confirm a signal source reaches every output channel while two Information sources run)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Activate two Information sources
2. Trigger a signal source
3. Record the output channels carrying the signal source
tcs.expected_result:
1. Both Information sources are active
2. The signal source is raised
3. Every output channel carries the signal source
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: Partial coverage, ruled at package 08 section 2.4. 4866916 states only the mixing onto all output channels; the leaf's ducking level for the Information sources has no counterpart in the anchor, so it is not written.

tcs.test_item:
When an Alternate Audio source is active concurrently with a Main Audio source, the Audio Management software shall combine the Alternate Audio stream with the active Main Audio stream according to the configured audio mixing policy and provide the resulting mixed audio for output

(Confirm Alternate Audio is mixed with Main Audio before it reaches the outputs)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play a Main Audio source
2. Activate an Alternate Audio source
3. Record the audio present at the speaker and external amplifier feed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Main Audio source plays
2. The Alternate Audio source becomes active
3. The speaker and external amplifier feed carries both sources mixed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866817, in scope under R-AM14: the chapter heading names CarPlay but the requirement is a mixing behaviour, and the upstream produced SWE1_AMM leaves for it. Out-of-pool anchor, corroborated by the full text (R-AM2').

tcs.test_item:
When an active Alternate Audio source requests ducking, the Audio Management software shall apply the configured ducking attenuation to the active Main Audio source within <vent off>

(Confirm a ducking request attenuates Main Audio while Alternate Audio holds its level)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play a Main Audio source at a known level
2. Activate an Alternate Audio source that carries a ducking request
3. Measure the Main Audio level against its starting level and record it
4. Record the Alternate Audio level
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Main Audio source plays at the set level
2. The Alternate Audio source becomes active with a ducking request
3. The Main Audio level is -16 dB below its starting level
4. The Alternate Audio holds its level
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866818, in scope under R-AM14. The attenuation <Vent off> is defined at CFTS019-4867782 as -16 dB, so the value is spec-sourced. It stays distinct from <Vent Nav Off> at 9 steps, which belongs to the navigation chain. Out-of-pool anchor, corroborated by the full text (R-AM2'). R-AM18 retro station item 1: <Vent off> = -16 dB is defined at CFTS019-4867782, which is appended so the case cites the object defining the value it reads as well as the behaviour object.

tcs.test_item:
When an HFP call becomes active, the Audio Management software shall identify active user-initiated playback sources that support pause or stop operations and shall issue the appropriate playback interruption request for those sources until the HFP call is terminated

(Confirm a pausable playback source is paused for the duration of a hands-free call)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play a CD
2. Establish a hands-free call
3. Record the transport state of the CD
4. End the hands-free call
5. Record the transport state of the CD again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CD plays
2. The hands-free call audio is active
3. The CD reports the paused state
4. The hands-free call ends
5. The CD resumes
tcs.reasoning: 4866484, ruled at package 08 section 2.5 after route 2 found it. Taken over the neighbouring 4866485 on two grounds: its Radio list carries R1L-R, and its text stops at HFP where 4866485 also covers E-Call and R-Call, wider than the leaf.
